name: trace
description: TRACE — durable context, planning, and delivery.

plugins.name: trace
plugins.description: TRACE core: durable context for AI-assisted development. Sets up the docs structure and AGENTS.md, records architecture decisions, distils durable knowledge as you work, validates the conventions, and measures context weight.

plugins.name: trace-plan
plugins.description: TRACE planning: specs with acceptance criteria, local epics, and browser review for both workflows.

plugins.name: trace-git
plugins.description: TRACE delivery add-on: commit messages and PR descriptions in a predictable What / Approach / Updated context shape. No Conventional-Commits taxonomy.

plugins.name: trace-full
plugins.description: Everything TRACE ships, behind one install: the docs core plus the planning and delivery add-ons. Install this if you don't want to choose.
